title: Spinach & Pepper Frittata with Cottage Cheese
description: A baked frittata blending eggs and cottage cheese with roasted peppers, spinach and parmesan.
steps: Beat the eggs with cottage cheese, garlic, half the parmesan, spinach, peppers, nutmeg and pepper.
Pour into a lined tin, top with tomatoes and remaining parmesan.
Bake at 190C for 40 minutes until set and puffed, then cool and cut into wedges.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food spinach & pepper frittata

notes: Cottage cheese roughly doubles the protein of a normal frittata for the same calories — slice and keep for 3-4 days.
